edit.description: Opposite time-order control; equal integral of RMS ratios

policy.knots_origin: predeclared_intervention; not a discovered biological stage

failure_modes: Affinity is the primary objective but no decoded final affinity labels are present in the role input, so the expected affinity benefit of W3 is unverified; the dose ordering is association evidence from coordinate contrasts, not measured final benefit.

The dose lane changes only registered dose_factors; reward scalar multiplication is insufficient under RMS normalization, so any apparent effect must be attributed to the compiled dose table, not to a rescaled reward.
Equal sum(dt*w) is only a ratio budget; per-seed flow scales and the safety caps (minimum_dose_factor 0.25, maximum_dose_factor 2.0) require realized-dose auditing before the recipe is credited.

Strain and structural validity are secondary and are not assessed here; a coordinate-contrast match does not establish improved affinity, and changed chemical graphs would need separate validity checks.

Temporal profiles are unavailable (temporal_profiles_available=false) and only soft-mass landmark features were queried, so the reversal pattern is not confirmed on local covariance or displacement features.
If a feature with an accepted polynomial representation and consistent first/last rate sign across independent batches were found, H001 would be falsified and this edit would lose its basis.
rationale: H001 states the landmark soft-mass coordinates carry large early-window rate contrasts that reverse by the late window, i.e. a time-varying contrast rather than a fixed coordinate target. The continuous-trend rows confirm this: whole-window z magnitudes are small while first/last rate z values are large and frequently opposite in sign, no polynomial representation is accepted, and extrapolation is disallowed. Under the dose lane the only registered lever that acts on this time-order contrast is the dose_factors table, and W3_early_strong_control is the registered recipe whose dose_factors are high early and low late (the mirror of W1_early_soft), matching the observed early-strong/late-reversed contrast. W2_middle_peak is a symmetric mid-window emphasis and does not encode the early-vs-late ordering the evidence reports. delta_A is held at 1.0 in all three recipes, consistent with the frozen-curvature constraint, and the reward view, teacher mixture and eta are unchanged. This is a predeclared intervention, not a discovered stage boundary; the knots_origin field says so explicitly.
